Title: Tomatoes (full-resolution SOG test conversion)
Original title: Scan was created on my DIY automated rig.
Author: Grail (https://superspl.at/user?id=grail)
Original source: https://superspl.at/scene/2826d2c0
Three.js source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/examples/models/spz/tomatoes.v4.spz
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Change made for this repository:
- Transcoded all 445,409 Gaussians from SPZ v4 to bundled SOG v2 without
  decimation, filtering, SH band reduction, or other data-reduction steps.

Conversion tool:
- @playcanvas/splat-transform 3.0.0
- Source commit: daf63383f32effe5cd63faa67ff030d39bfa543e

Converted SHA-256:
992d569261421a85e8c2f08087172b01190c288036719b97938cb29b38d77c99

Reproduction command:
splat-transform -g 0 tomatoes.v4.spz tomatoes.sog
